items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: All I knew was Feast. Feast? Feast, but I never know his full name.

ctx.x: Did you, do you remember your cousin's name?
All I knew was Feast. Feast? Feast, but I never know his full name. And he was a piano player?
Yeah, all I knew was Feast. Did he play alone or with bands or both?
